content:
Hi folks!

I and @Claire Wang have created Prismriver (Lean Reservoir, GitHub Mirror), a library for formalization of music theory and algorithmic composition.

Prismriver contains a flexible representation system of pitch and intervals as torsors, tuning systems, and scores. It can export to MusicXML and Alda. For example, the code below plays five notes of Necrofantasia with Alda

import Prismriver
#play ♩[e4 c'4 b4 d4 e2]

I wrote an explanation of Prismriver here: https://leni.sh/post/260801-prismriver/

The paper was accepted into FARM '26.

Feel free to ask us any questions and check out the project! Lots of potential future work - if you’re interested in collaborating or extending, reach out! 

Interesting links

  • Lulu https://github.com/iehality/Lulu - Lean music composition tool that converts Lean code to MusicXML. 

  • Alda https://github.com/alda-lang/alda - programming language for music composition. We use Alda for playback with Prismriver synthesized compositions. 

  • Musescore - software to render musicxml https://musescore.org/en/download - pieces composed with Prismriver can be exported to musicxml, which generates music notation.

Upcoming Events

  • I’ll be giving a talk on Prismriver at the NYC Lean meetup on 8/16. Check out #Geographic locality > New York City, USA 

  • @Leni Aniva will be presenting Prismriver at the FARM workshop at ICFP on 8/24 (https://icfp26.sigplan.org/home/farm-2026#About). We will both be there!
